semantic.justification: Task202610231627-0F8SYR: Writer import API attachment uses canonical document/nodes/registered positions/items rather than a separate document representation. Paragraph identity and range bound to the existing text node. Only the current canonical Writer core slice is represented. Full UNO service metadata/query interfaces, listeners, interactive undo/actions, Unicode cursor navigation, layout, unsupported character/table/conditional styles, ranges in unsupported sections, expanded bookmarks and wider properties remain unverified or unported. DomainMapper, OOXML package parser and export are outside this task; no whole-module parity claim. Task SWRD7X follows native XMLParaContext::endFastElement APPEND_PARAGRAPH and XMLTextImportHelper::DeleteParagraph preferred paragraph-component deletion, rather than split/join cleanup that loses empty-cell character items. Actual cursor enumeration, SwXParagraph XComponent deletion and the bounded single-paragraph DelFullPara owner retain paragraph identity and direct formatting. Explicit host Release only releases borrowed API result positions. Tests cover cursor/mark identity, exhaustion, repeated disposal, last-paragraph refusal, populated/empty superscript cell ODT roundtrip and the original no-component deletion fallback. Broader enumeration, redline, fieldmark, undo, event-listener and document-disposal contracts remain outside this bounded integration repair; prior semantic statuses are unchanged.
